Definition: to trench; by implication, to throw forth; to wall up, whether literal (to build a wall) or figurative (to estop)
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Qal) to bore, dig, dig for water; 2) to be cold; 2a) (Hiphil) to make or keep cool; 3) (Pilpel) destroy, break down
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
